sources.title: Olson, A combinatorial problem on finite Abelian groups I
sources.notes: Olson original JNT abstract inspected in S001; exact p-group equality now independently source-stated in the primary Gao-Geroldinger 2006 survey Theorem 3.1 (SRC-0003), not an Olson full-proof inspection.

sources.title: Gao–Geroldinger, Zero-sum problems in finite abelian groups: a survey
sources.notes: Original Gao-Geroldinger survey PDF pp.5-6 directly inspected: Thm 3.1 d=d* for p-groups/rank<=2, Conj 3.5 rank 3, definitions d=D-1; screenshots viewed. Proof of Olson theorem not rechecked.

sources.title: Gao, On Davenport's constant of finite abelian groups with rank three
sources.notes: Bibliography confirmed on AIMS publisher's reference list.

sources.title: Girard–Schmid, Direct zero-sum problems for certain groups of rank three
sources.notes: Girard-Schmid original v2 HTML abstract, introduction and Theorem 2.7 inspected: direct multiwise/eta results apply to C2 ⊕ C_n2 ⊕ C_n3 with 2|n2|n3; first invariant 2, not C6^3.

sources.title: Zakarczemny, Note on the Davenport's constant for finite abelian groups with rank three
sources.notes: Primary HTML theorem/lemma/abstract inspected; note apparent typo in its Lemma 3.4 rank-two formula, do not import.

sources.title: Wang, A generalization of Kruyswijk-Olson theorem on Davenport constant in commutative semigroups
sources.notes: Publisher references [11] are Gao–Geroldinger 2006; see REF-11 identification.

sources.title: Bhowmik–Schlage-Puchta, Davenport's constant for groups of the form Z3 ⊕ Z3 ⊕ Z3d
sources.notes: Original BSP 2007 Proposition 1 p.3 and Proposition 8 proof pp.10–11 inspected. Subscript multiwise D3=15,D4=18; superscript D^3=17 is at-most-three-term zero-sum, not multiwise. Auxiliary case proof not independently closed.

sources.title: Bhowmik–Schlage-Puchta, Davenport's constant for groups with large exponent
sources.notes: Original author PDF statements and parts of proof inspected: eta(C5^3)=33, D3(C5^3)≤33 source-stated; eta p>7 and p=7 cases distinct, full imported axioms not matched. Visible editorial annotations including 'Forgot the second claim'. Journal DOI 10.1090/conm/579/11515.

sources.title: Freeze–Schmid, Remarks on a generalization of the Davenport constant
sources.notes: Original Freeze–Schmid author PDF Theorem 3.6 p.9: D_k(G)≤D_{D_k(H)}(G/H), k positive. For k=1 agrees with programme-proved S002 induction. Correct DOI 10.1016/j.disc.2010.07.028; prior 2009.07.002 incorrect.

sources.title: Delorme–Ordaz–Quiroz, Some remarks on Davenport constant
sources.notes: Title, venue and theorem not inspected; provisional discovery link.

sources.title: Royal Holloway thesis on C3⊕C3⊕C3d proof reconstruction
sources.notes: Royal Holloway Sheikh thesis Chapter 4 indexed primary opening warns about 2007 rank-three-family proof gaps for gcd(d,6)≠1 and incorrect Remark 4.3.11; full university thesis PDF blocked HTTP 403. No comprehensive proof review.

sources.title: Combinatorica article on k-th Davenport constants of rank-two groups
sources.notes: Exact DOI/authors unverified; inherited pointer only.

sources.title: Yiu, The fourth generalized Davenport constant of C5^3
sources.notes: Original Yiu September 2026 arXiv abstract reports D4(C5^3)=30, Dk=5k+10 k≥2; full main proof and ancillary code/certificates not inspected.

sources.title: Grinsztajn, An upper bound for the Davenport constant of C_n^3
sources.notes: Author repo tree 848b081e40ecd769017a6199ebcb4e31fe125483 contains written PDF blob 5a698f1edee8cf0b1fabcb8b865f0fd04617ab0d; PDF binary body inaccessible to source tools, README/conditional Lean axiom statements inspected. 4n-P(n)-2 not independently audited at proof level.

sources.title: Wang, Disproof of a Conjectured Upper Bound for the Davenport Constant
sources.notes: Primary abstract: unbounded gap D-D* fixed rank >=8; no rank-three implication.

sources.title: Tao optimization problems page: Davenport constant for C_n^3
sources.notes: Tao/optimization problem secondary summary consulted to find Grinsztajn; primary author README/Lean source separately inspected as SRC-0016. Secondary description alone not a mathematical certificate.
